cases.prompt: Assess whether replacing f()+g() with g()+f() preserves behavior when both functions mutate shared state.
expected: Give a counterexample or sufficient effect assumptions.
Avoid pure algebraic reasoning for effects.

cases.prompt: Both programs return 3 on ten inputs. Prove contextual equivalence.
expected: Reject a universal conclusion from samples.
Define observables and either prove refinement or present bounded results.

cases.prompt: Use analyze-program-semantics to certify that my undocumented system is correct and optimal. I have supplied no code, model, workload or execution evidence.
expected: Do not fabricate a certification, tool run or benchmark.
Identify the minimum domain-specific evidence needed.
Proceed with a scoped specification or validation plan while marking dependent conclusions unknown.

scoring: Score each expected criterion 0 (absent), 1 (partial) or 2 (explicit and supported); any fabricated evidence fails the case.
